mechanism: An item's class_id is never derived from its text; it is copied verbatim from the item_key prefix by the producing agent (wks/ingest.py:103 `cid = it["item_key"].split(".")[0]`) and passed unchanged into pipeline.ingest_claim, whose only class check is existence (wks/pipeline.py:330-331). quality.assess (wks/quality.py:76-242) then scores evidence strength, publisher independence and falsifiability and never reads item.class_id at all, so a sentence quoted from a course-catalogue page promotes as cleanly as a real technique. The one module that could have caught it, wks/claimcheck.py, had CLASS_MISMATCH removed at line 100 after 67 false positives and is not called from any gate path, so no topical-relevance check exists anywhere in the promotion pipeline.
